title: Comex Delivery Fees
takeaway: Comex delivery fees range from $15 to $50 per 1,000 ounces.

data.label: Delivery Fee Range
data.evidence: Currently, Comex delivery fees typically range from $15 to $30 per 1,000 ounces.

narration: Comex delivery fees vary based on quantity and shipping distance. As of now, the typical range is between $15 and $50 for every 1,000 ounces of silver delivered.
